what_happened: Task 612's free-text description field is a verbatim, word-for-word duplicate of the description belonging to a separate, correctly-sited .dotfiles task (project_number 138, retire_machine_wide_sapience_surface, status not_started), narrating the SECOND-HALF machine-wide-removal work and asserting 'This task belongs in /home/benjamin/.dotfiles'. Task 612's own file_scope (agent-system/extensions/sapience/settings-fragment.json, manifest.json, EXTENSION.md, README.md, index-entries.json, two context/domain files, scripts/), title, project_name (gate_sapience_activation_behind_extension), and siting (specs dir under /home/benjamin/.config/nvim) all correctly identify it as the FIRST-HALF extension-side task. The description's own embedded ORDERING CONSTRAINT text is self-referentially paradoxical when read as task 612's own instructions (it calls itself 'the second half' depending on a companion of its own project name). This is a task-authoring/paste defect, not a real blocker in the underlying two-part change itself.

Found a complete, already-shipped precedent for the per-repo MCP-server-registration mechanism task 612 actually needs to build: the lean extension's install-lean-lsp-session-hook.sh + hooks/lean-lsp-register-project.sh + scripts/setup-lean-mcp.sh, which install a stable USER-LEVEL (never repo-local .claude/) SessionStart hook that detects per-project applicability and writes/repairs that project's own .projects[<path>].mcpServers entry in ~/.claude.json. Also confirmed via git diff that the extension settings-merge engine (lua/neotex/plugins/ai/shared/extensions/merge.lua) already fully supports merging a hooks object (SessionStart/PreToolUse/etc., with dedup and clean unmerge-on-unload) into a consuming repo's .claude/settings.local.json, not just permissions.allow -- so the 5 Sapience hooks and 7 read-tool grants can both move into settings-fragment.json using an already-proven mechanism; only the ~/.claude.json mcpServers piece needs the lean-lsp-style stable-path hook+writer pattern.

Empirically resolved (by reading deep_merge/is_hook_event_array in lua/neotex/plugins/ai/shared/extensions/merge.lua, not assuming the research report's framing) that 4 of the 5 Sapience hooks carry NO matcher key, so is_hook_event_array rejects their arrays and they merge via the generic tracked array-append branch (deep_equal dedup, tracked as appended/new_array, reversed by remove_tracked). Only PreToolUse (matcher Edit|Write|MultiEdit) takes the matcher-aware hook_merged path. Both paths are tracked and cleanly reversible, and prune_empty_hooks drops an emptied hooks key, so no matcher needs to be invented and no SessionStart behavior change is required.

The lean precedent this task is told to mirror achieves durable SessionStart registration by writing BOTH $HOME/.claude/settings.json AND $HOME/.dotfiles/config/claude/settings.json. This task is forbidden to touch .dotfiles. Verified read-only in ~/.dotfiles/modules/home/core/dotfiles.nix that hooks is in the enforced key set [_NOTE,env,hooks,model,permissions,statusLine] and is reset from .dotfiles config/claude/settings.json on every home-manager switch whenever that source has a hooks key (it does, and will keep it for the inhibitor and lean entries after the companion task removes only the Sapience ones). So a user-level-only registration seeded by the sapience installer is wiped by the next home-manager switch. Planned as a named, documented residual with a loud installer warning plus verifier detection; closing it requires a .dotfiles edit owned by the companion retire_machine_wide_sapience_surface task.

Phase 2's Scope Hypothesis predicted suite_selection_select would return the new suite name for scripts/setup-sapience-mcp.sh once test-sapience-mcp-registration.sh landed (naming it textually, stratum b). It still returns __FULL_SWEEP__ both pre- and post-staging, because the library's own documented scope excludes a non-core extension's un-deployed source-store path entirely (not merely an unestablished stratum-b reference). Confirmed by running run-all.sh --only test-sapience-mcp-registration.sh from the SOURCE-STORE entry point (agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/tests/run-all.sh), which discovers and passes the suite directly by basename -- so Phase 2's own named verification criterion is satisfied by the source-store invocation; the deployed-mode full-sweep result is an artifact of pre-deploy state, re-checked at Phase 7's deploy step.
